welcome.headline: DISCOVER YOUR CREATIVE CAREER
welcome.text: Discover your creative potential and see yourself in the world of digital media.

consent.headline: Before we take your photo
consent.textAi: Your photo is used only to create your career portrait. It is sent to Google's AI service to make the image, and it is not saved on this kiosk. Everything is cleared when you finish or walk away.
consent.textLocal: Your photo is used only to create your career portrait. It stays on this kiosk and is not saved. Everything is cleared when you finish or walk away.

photo.instruction: Take a photo to discover your creative future.
photo.noCamera: We can't reach the camera. Please ask a staff member for help.

quiz.hintStart: Tilt or look towards your answer and hold
quiz.hintStepBack: Step back a little so everything fits

photographer.title: Photographer
photographer.description: You see stories in a single frame. You notice light, emotion and the perfect moment, and you capture it so others can feel it too.
photographer.aiPrompt: Transform this photo into a photorealistic portrait of the same person working as a professional photographer. They are holding a professional DSLR camera with a large lens, standing in a modern photography studio with softbox lights, a backdrop stand and warm studio lighting.

videographer.title: Videographer
videographer.description: You think in moving pictures. You love planning shots, filming action and turning footage into stories that pull people in.
videographer.aiPrompt: Transform this photo into a photorealistic portrait of the same person working as a professional videographer. They are operating a cinema video camera on a tripod, on a film set with LED production lights, a boom microphone and monitors.

designer.title: Graphic Designer
designer.description: You speak in colour, shape and type. You turn ideas into posters, logos and visuals that people remember.
designer.aiPrompt: Transform this photo into a photorealistic portrait of the same person working as a professional graphic designer. They are in a bright creative studio, using a drawing tablet and stylus in front of a large monitor showing colourful poster designs, with artwork and colour swatches on the wall.

creator.title: Content Creator
creator.description: You know how to grab attention and share ideas. You entertain, inspire and build a community around what you create.
creator.aiPrompt: Transform this photo into a photorealistic portrait of the same person working as a content creator. They are in a modern home studio holding a smartphone, with a ring light, a podcast microphone on an arm, and colourful LED lighting in the background.

aiPromptRules: Keep the person's face, identity, skin tone, age, hairstyle and expression clearly recognisable. Keep their clothing style and any head covering (such as a tudung or headscarf) exactly as worn in the photo. Make it natural, flattering, modest and professional. Portrait orientation. Do not add any text, logos or watermarks.

questions.text: What do you enjoy doing the most?

options.text: Taking photos of people, places, and interesting moments.
Recording videos and capturing exciting moments.
Creating posters, logos, and digital artwork.
Making social media posts, sharing ideas, and entertaining people.

questions.text: Which activity sounds the most exciting?

options.text: Finding the perfect angle to capture a beautiful photo.
Planning and filming a short movie or video.
Designing a creative poster for an event.
Creating a fun TikTok or Instagram video.

questions.text: If you could use one creative tool, which would you choose?

options.text: A professional camera and different lenses.
A video camera, microphone, and tripod.
A computer with digital design software.
A smartphone with content creation apps.

questions.text: What would you most like people to notice about your work?

options.text: The beautiful moments and emotions I capture.
The stories I tell through moving images.
The visual style, colours, and designs I create.
The entertaining or inspiring content I share.

questions.text: Imagine you are working on a school event. What role would you choose?

options.text: Taking memorable photos of the event.
Filming and editing an event highlight video.
Designing the event poster and promotional graphics.
Creating social media content and behind-the-scenes updates.

ar.note: Head controls for the quiz. Raise the numbers if answers get picked by accident; lower them if it's hard to choose. Add ?debug to the URL to see live values.
